baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence جَادَلُوا بِٱلْبَٰطِلِ لِيُدْحِضُوا بِهِ ٱلْحَقَّ at words 13-17.
baseline_models.mechanism: The clause coordinates worked tension, absent stability, slipping, and fixity. Disputation is not merely false speech: it is a tightly made but groundless instrument intended to remove the public footing of what remains fixed.

activation_trace.role: Tight twisting supplies the worked, tensioned image and functions as the construction of the adversarial discourse.
Entangled contest supplies the direct speech conflict and functions as the social form of that constructed instrument.
Departure from truth and stability supplies the unstable material from which the instrument is made.
A foot slipping and losing purchase supplies the intended effect: making truth lose practical footing.
Reality-fixed stability supplies the resistant object whose public position, not reality, is being attacked.

changed_reading.before: They argued falsely in order to refute the truth.
changed_reading.after: They engineered an entangled, groundless discourse to make fixed truth lose traction among its hearers.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The intention هَمَّتْ, the two occurrences of أخذ at words 12 and 18, and the closing عِقَابِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A collective intention to seize the messenger is answered by an accomplished divine seizure of the intending collectives. Repetition of the same root reverses subject and object, while punishment names the adverse consequence that follows the offense.

activation_trace.role: An intention forming inwardly supplies the unrealized first motion of the capture attempt.
Grasping and captivity span both occurrences and function as the hinge that transfers captor agency from the nations to God.
Punishment after an offense supplies the trailing consequence that completes the reversed seizure.

changed_reading.before: The nations planned violence and were then punished.
changed_reading.after: Their intended grasp is turned back as an accomplished counter-grasp, with punishment presented as the consequence following their own capture project.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The temporal frame قَبْلَهُمْ ... مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ and the distribution قَوْمُ ... ٱلْأَحْزَابُ ... كُلُّ أُمَّةٍ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Before and after create a succession frame; people, parties, totality, and community distribute one repeated action over different collective forms. The ayah compresses history into a reproducible social pattern rather than merely listing offenders.

activation_trace.role: Temporal precedence supplies the opening position in a sequence of recurring collectives.
A group cohering around a view supplies coalition as one social carrier of the repeated opposition.
Posteriority after what precedes extends the pattern beyond the first named people.
Encompassing totality distributes the capture intention across every member of the class.
Community or kind supplies the repeatable collective unit to which the same mechanism attaches.

changed_reading.before: Noah's people and later parties did similar wrongs.
changed_reading.after: Successive kinds of collectivity repeatedly reconstitute the same anti-messenger mechanism across time.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative denial كَذَّبَتْ, the relational رَسُولِهِمْ, and the movement from intention to seizure.
baseline_models.mechanism: Takdhib assigns lying to a thing or person. Here a community reclassifies its own messenger as false, then moves from that social label to a plan of physical control; denial functions as authorization for coercion rather than as private nonbelief.

activation_trace.role: Attributing lying to a person supplies the public relabeling that precedes coercive action.
Messenger and message supply the community-linked envoy whom the community recodes as a liar.
Formed intention supplies the transition from discursive classification to planned action.
Captivity supplies the coercive endpoint licensed by the relabeling and later reversed upon its agents.

changed_reading.before: The communities disbelieved their messengers and tried to arrest them.
changed_reading.after: Each community publicly manufactures its messenger as a liar, and that classification clears the way for attempted capture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus question about punishment is twice expanded into travel, directed looking, outcome, and surviving marks. The first expansion immediately recalls divine seizure. The question therefore becomes a prompt to reconstruct the counter-grasp from material traces, not only an exclamation about severity.

activation_trace.role: The last state or outcome supplies the focus question's consequence horizon.
Going and moving supply the bodily procedure by which the hearer approaches historical evidence.
Directing sight or insight supplies inspection as the epistemic operation applied to the outcome.
A remaining sign of what once was supplies the observable residue from which punishment is inferred.
Being taken to account for wrongdoing identifies the event whose marks the traveler reads.
The repeated outcome branch near the surah's end turns the earlier expansion into a framing refrain.
A second occurrence of surviving marks confirms that visible residue, not hearsay alone, carries the warning.

structural_cues: 40:21 and 40:82 repeat يَسِيرُوا ... فَيَنظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ around the focus's فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ.
40:21 places فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ after strength and آثار, while 40:82 repeats strength and آثار near the surah's close.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies travel, inspection, outcome, traces, and repeated seizure; I infer that the focus question solicits evidentiary reconstruction. A live alternative is that the travel formulas only amplify warning without making the focus question procedurally observational.

changed_reading.before: The closing question asks the hearer to register how severe a past punishment was.
changed_reading.after: The closing question sends the hearer to inspect the footprint of consequence and reconstruct how attempted captors themselves came to be taken.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Pharaoh sequence instantiates the compressed pattern in real time: the court names the messenger a liar, Pharaoh proposes killing him, an insider redistributes the risk of lying and truth, then explicitly invokes the Day of the Parties and the habitual case of Noah's people and those after them. The focus is thus a reusable diagnosis of the current polity, not a sealed past report.

activation_trace.role: Capture supplies the focus script whose political instantiation the later sequence makes explicit.
Assigning lying to Moses supplies the court's concrete act of coercive relabeling.
Putting to death supplies the explicit political content of the focus's more general intended seizure.
The grouped lie occurrences place a hypothetical lie upon its speaker and function as the insider's reversal of the court's accusation.
Established soundness supplies the live alternative whose promised consequence may reach the accusers.
A coalition cohering around a view repeats the focus label and positions Pharaoh's audience inside its warning pattern.
Habit and continuing practice make the Noah sequence a recurring social mechanism rather than a loose comparison.
A people-group repeats the focus's Noah collective within the insider's warning to his own people.
Posteriority repeats the focus's open-ended succession and leaves Pharaoh's society able to join the sequence.

structural_cues: 40:24-28 moves from the label كَذَّابٌ to Pharaoh's أَقْتُلْ مُوسَىٰ and then to the believing man's conditional defense.
40:30-31 directly reuses ٱلْأَحْزَابِ, قَوْمِ نُوحٍ, and مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ from the focus's compressed history.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the liar-label, explicit killing proposal, insider's risk argument, and direct historical echo; I infer that Pharaoh's polity is entering the focus script while it unfolds. A live alternative is that the Day of the Parties remains only an analogy to past catastrophes, not a classification of Pharaoh's court.

changed_reading.before: Every earlier community tried to seize its messenger.
changed_reading.after: The focus names a script that Pharaoh's court now performs: label the envoy false, convert that label into lethal policy, and thereby join the succession of parties it invokes as merely past.

context_deltas.mechanism: Moses comes with manifest warrant, whereas the surah twice defines hostile disputation as occurring without any warrant that came to its agents and locates its drive in magnified self-importance. The focus's باطل is thereby sharpened from generic falsity into discourse that imitates authority while lacking authorization.

activation_trace.role: Entangled verbal contest supplies the focus activity that later contexts diagnose by its missing warrant.
Claiming what has no reality supplies the focus category that the warrant contrast specifies.
Compelling proof supplies the messenger-side warrant against which hostile argument is measured.
The repeated verbal contest identifies the focus dispute as a recurring behavior, not an isolated episode.
Compelling proof appears under explicit negation and functions as the absent authorization of the disputants.
A second recurrence of the same proofless contest turns the diagnosis into a surah-level signature.
Magnifying something in the chest supplies status inflation as the internal pressure behind unauthorized dispute.

structural_cues: 40:35 and 40:56 repeat يُجَٰدِلُونَ ... بِغَيْرِ سُلْطَٰنٍ أَتَىٰهُمْ.
40:23 gives Moses سُلْطَٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ before the two proofless-dispute formulas.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a messenger with manifest warrant, disputants without warrant, and greatness in their chests; I infer that false argument compensates for missing authority by performing dominance. A live alternative is the narrower reading that باطل means only unsupported proof, without a status mechanism.

changed_reading.before: They use propositions that are false.
changed_reading.after: They stage proofless contest as if it possessed compelling authority, using argumentative dominance to compensate for warrant they never received.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's slipping image is activated by a sequence of beautification, blockage from a path, counter-guidance toward a straight path, and the turning of disputants. False argument works by shaping movement: it makes a bad project attractive, blocks access, and turns hearers away rather than actually altering truth.

activation_trace.role: Loss of footing supplies the focus's spatial effect and anchors the later path-control reading.
Making something appear good supplies attraction as the first operation of directional manipulation.
Turning away supplies blockage as the second operation of the same route-control mechanism.
An extended traversable road supplies the trajectory from which Pharaoh is barred.
A straight path away from error supplies the believing speaker's counter-route to Pharaoh's manipulation.
The recurring verbal contest identifies the people being redirected at the surah's later pivot.
Turning something from its face supplies the resulting diversion of the disputants.

structural_cues: 40:37 joins beautified bad action, being barred from the path, and a plot ending in ruin.
40:38 immediately answers with ٱتَّبِعُونِ أَهْدِكُمْ سَبِيلَ ٱلرَّشَادِ, and 40:69 joins disputation to أَنَّىٰ يُصْرَفُونَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies slipperiness, beautification, blockage, a guided road, and disputants being turned; I infer that public argument controls trajectories of attention and allegiance. A live alternative is that the road language is a broader moral frame rather than a description of argumentative mechanics.

changed_reading.before: False argument tries to defeat a true claim.
changed_reading.after: False argument tries to reroute a public: it decorates the wrong course, obstructs the sound one, and makes hearers slip away from truth without moving truth itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated context seizures are explicitly tied to wrongdoing and rejected messengers. In the Pharaoh sequence, the believing speaker is shielded while the harm of the plot encloses Pharaoh's people; near the close, what was mocked encloses its mockers. The focus reversal is therefore differential: the intended victim can be protected while consequence closes around the capture project.

activation_trace.role: Capture across both focus occurrences supplies the reversible relation between intended victim and actual captive.
Taking to account for wrongdoing explicitly supplies the moral attachment of the counter-seizure.
A second taking after rejection of messengers confirms the repeated attachment between denial and seizure.
Protective deflection supplies the selective escape of the believing speaker from the plot's harm.
Descending harm that surrounds supplies enclosure as the form taken by the plotters' reversed outcome.
A second surrounding occurrence makes mocked warning itself the enclosure that finally reaches the mockers.

structural_cues: 40:21-22 repeats فَأَخَذَهُمُ after sins and rejection of messengers.
40:45 contrasts فَوَقَىٰهُ with وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ in one sentence; 40:83 repeats وَحَاقَ بِهِم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated accountable taking, protection of one speaker, and surrounding harm for the plotters; I infer a selective inversion in which the capture mechanism closes around its agents. A live alternative is that protection and enclosure are parallel outcomes without being a deliberate mirror of the focus's repeated أخذ.

changed_reading.before: God seizes the people who intended to seize a messenger.
changed_reading.after: The attempted capture is selectively inverted: its vulnerable witness can be shielded while the consequence generated by the plot closes around the plotters.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah relocates final efficacy from public disputation to adjudication: acts receive matching recompense, God judges by truth while rival invocations cannot judge, witnesses stand, and the closing messenger formula reserves signs for permission before judgment by truth makes falsifiers lose. False discourse may disturb public footing, but it cannot schedule or determine the verdict.

activation_trace.role: Reality-fixed truth supplies the focus object whose standing the adversaries try to disturb.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies the proportional logic of the later verdict.
Cutting judgment contrasts God's judgment by truth with the invoked rivals' inability and assigns decisive speech to the judge.
Presence with witnessing supplies the evidentiary assembly in which final standing is manifested.
Permission supplies the authorization governing when a messenger can bring a sign.
Decisive judgment supplies the transition from contested message to settled outcome when the divine command arrives.
Establishing and displaying truth supplies the criterion and effect of the final judgment.
Loss of truth and stability now characterizes the falsifiers themselves and functions as their verdict-position.

structural_cues: 40:17 states recompense for every soul with no injustice; 40:20 contrasts judgment by truth with inability to judge.
40:51 raises witnesses, and 40:78 sequences messenger, permitted sign, arrival of the command, judgment by truth, and loss of the falsifiers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies proportional recompense, exclusive judgment, witnesses, sign-permission, and a truth-verdict; I infer two levels of standing, provisional public traction and authorized final adjudication. A live alternative is that these contexts promise judgment without distinguishing it from the focus's immediate rhetorical contest.

changed_reading.before: Truth and falsehood compete as claims, after which punishment follows.
changed_reading.after: Falsehood can manipulate a claim's public footing, but truth's final standing belongs to an authorized court and timing that disputants cannot seize, simulate, or accelerate.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus presents parties braided together against a messenger. In the fire, argument relocates inside the former hierarchy: followers appeal to the arrogant, the leaders cannot relieve any share, and all stand under a judgment already made. Their outward argumentative solidarity proves temporary and unravels into mutual liability.

activation_trace.role: A group cohering around a view supplies the outward coalition whose durability is tested later.
Tight twisting supplies the apparent binding force of the coalition's shared dispute.
Contending with a would-be prevailing proof supplies the coalition's later inward argument.
Allegiance and succession identify the weak as followers and expose the hierarchy inside the former front.
Sufficiency appears as a failed question and functions as the leaders' inability to remove any portion of consequence.
Judgment between people closes the internal dispute and places both ranks under one settled decision.

structural_cues: 40:47 stages direct argument between ٱلضُّعَفَٰٓؤُا۟ and ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ over whether leaders can remove a share of fire.
40:48 answers that all are in it because God has already judged between the servants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an earlier coalition, a later follower-leader dispute, failed relief, and settled judgment; I infer that false argumentative unity unravels under consequence. A live alternative is that 40:47 depicts an analogous hierarchy rather than the same historical parties named by the focus.

changed_reading.before: The parties act as a united argumentative front against the messenger.
changed_reading.after: Their unity is only outward: once the counter-seizure arrives, the braided front separates into followers and leaders disputing responsibility without power to help one another.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it imports the root's patterned-garment image into communal denial. It remains anchored in كذب and in the context's beautified bad action while Pharaoh calls Moses a liar. Render it only as an exploratory analogy for deceptive presentation, not as a claim that the ayah denotes literal clothing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: كَذَّبَتْ and بِٱلْبَٰطِلِ, with the later pairing of Pharaoh's liar-label and beautified bad action.

activation_trace.role: A patterned garment that lies by its appearance supplies deceptive presentation as a form of enacted denial.
A claim with no reality supplies the false content concealed beneath the attractive presentation.
Assigning lying to Moses supplies the explicit accusation carried by Pharaoh's presentation.
Making bad action appear good supplies the contextual activation for reading denial as an attractive surface that misreports its state.

changed_reading.before: Denial consists in saying that the messenger is false.
changed_reading.after: Denial may also operate as a beautified public surface that lies by appearance, dressing a groundless political project as prudent truth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from the material branch of جدل into the later punishment image. It remains anchored in the focus's twisted dispute and doubled capture, then in connected restraints and dragging. Render it as a material echo of reversal, not as an etymological identity or a claim that argument literally causes chains.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The conjunction of the tightly twisted branch of جَدَلُوا with the two capture occurrences in لِيَأْخُذُوهُ ... فَأَخَذْتُهُمْ.

activation_trace.role: Tight twisting supplies argument as a braid-like instrument in the attempted capture.
A wrestling hold supplies bodily restraint and spans the intended grip and its reversal.
A collar restraining a limb supplies the later concrete state of those caught by the reversal.
Connected links supply a literal binding form that answers the focus's tightly worked argumentative form.
Dragging and extending supply the enforced movement of those whose own discourse sought to move truth.

changed_reading.before: Argument is followed by a separate punishment.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material echo, the tightly worked discourse used for capture returns in connected restraints that capture and move its makers.

strongest_changes: The repeated travel-look-outcome formula at 40:21 and 40:82 turns the focus's final question into trace-based historical inspection.
The Pharaoh sequence performs the focus script in real time: liar-label, intended killing, insider counterargument, then explicit reuse of the Parties and Noah succession.
Proofless dispute becomes both unauthorized performance of power and route control, while final truth is reserved for an authorized verdict.
The doubled capture becomes selective enclosure: witnesses may be protected while the consequence of the plot surrounds its agents.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly reopened the focus rather than merely commenting on it: exact language recurred in the outcome refrains, Pharaoh's episode, the proofless-disputation formulas, the path imagery, the judgment sequence, and the closing messenger formula. This supported coexisting historical, political, spatial, judicial, and material readings without collapsing them.
remaining_uncertainties: The route-control model may describe the mechanics of public argument, or the path lexicon may remain a broader moral frame.
The follower-leader dispute at 40:47 may expose the same kind of coalition rather than the identical parties named in the focus.
The deceptive-garment and argument-chain readings are branch-anchored but should remain explicitly exploratory.
